entities.name: Manmohan Singh Liberhan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manmohan Singh Liberhan is a retired Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court, India. For 17 years he headed the Liberhan Ayodhya Commission of Inquiry, which prepared a report on the Babri Mosque demolition.
